blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Benedicto College (BC) Cheetahs survived a furious University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors comeback to escape with a 67-64 overtime victory in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (Cesafi) Season 26 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday, November 22, at the Cebu Coliseum. What appeared to be a routine victory for the Cheetahs turned into a tightly contested battle between two teams with Final Four aspirations, featuring 11 lead changes and eight deadlocks before the game went into overtime at 58-all.
